name: DaVinci Tower by Pagani
key_amenities: Rooftop infinity pool with Downtown & Burj Khalifa views
Pagani-curated bespoke interiors and carbon-fiber detailing
Private resident elevators
State-of-the-art fitness center, sauna & steam suites
24/7 dedicated white-glove concierge
Smart home automation
description: DaVinci Tower is an architectural masterpiece on the Dubai Water Canal, crafted in collaboration with legendary Italian hypercar atelier Pagani. Every detail channels Leonardo da Vinci's pursuit of perfection and Pagani's carbon-fiber craftsmanship.
investment_highlights: High rental yields in Business Bay waterfront, iconic collector-grade trophy asset, capital appreciation potential.

name: Tierra Viva by Automobili Lamborghini
location: Benahavís, Marbella, Costa del Sol, Spain
key_amenities: Tiered multi-level private infinity pools
Direct Mediterranean sea and Gibraltar panoramas
Lamborghini super sports car design lines and custom interiors
Private spa, wine cellar, home cinema, and gym
Gated community with 24/7 biometric security
Private manicured rooftop gardens
description: Tierra Viva is an exclusive gated community of 53 bespoke luxury villas suspended on the cliffs of Benahavís, Marbella. Designed by DarGlobal and inspired by the sharp aerodynamic lines and power of Automobili Lamborghini.
investment_highlights: Ultra-rare European branded villa development, prime European Golden Visa jurisdiction, strong resale value in Marbella's Golden Mile.

name: Urban Oasis by Missoni
location: Dubai Water Canal, Business Bay, Dubai, UAE
key_amenities: Direct boardwalk access on Dubai Water Canal
Missoni signature vibrant color palettes and textured mosaics
Infinity swimming pool suspended over the canal
World-class gymnasium and wellness center
Covered parking and 24/7 security
Landscaped outdoor lounge decks
description: Urban Oasis by Missoni is a vibrant residential tower located on the Dubai Canal. Designed by the Italian fashion house Missoni, it exudes retro-chic Italian Riviera elegance coupled with panoramic waterfront and downtown vistas.
investment_highlights: Prime canal-front location, strong short-term and long-term rental demand, exceptional Airbnb yield potential.

name: Aida by Trump International
category: Master Clifftop Golf Resort & Branded Residences
key_amenities: 100-meter dramatic clifftop elevation overlooking the Sea of Oman
18-hole Trump International championship golf course
Trump International Luxury Hotel & Spa
Clifftop infinity beach club and fine dining restaurants
Hiking trails, mountain bike paths, and wellness retreats
Oman residency visa eligibility for foreign property buyers
description: Perched 100 meters above the Sea of Oman, AIDA is an iconic 3.5 million square meter master development combining dramatic natural canyon cliffs, championship golf, and the world-renowned hospitality of Trump International.
investment_highlights: Qualifies for Omani Investor Golden Visa, zero personal income tax in Oman, pristine natural haven attracting international high-net-worth tourism.

name: Trump Tower Jeddah
key_amenities: Unobstructed views of the Red Sea and Jeddah Waterfront
Exclusive Trump Members Club & executive lounges
Sky spa, hydrotherapy pools, and private cabanas
Michelin-tier fine dining and private banquet spaces
Valet service, private elevator lobbies, and round-the-clock security
description: Marking Trump Organization's flagship entry into the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia with DarGlobal, Trump Tower Jeddah stands as a premier architectural beacon on the Red Sea, redefining luxury living for Saudi Vision 2030.
investment_highlights: First-of-its-kind international branded high-rise on Jeddah's Corniche, prime beneficiary of Jeddah Central development.

name: W Residences Dubai Harbour
key_amenities: Panoramic views of Palm Jumeirah, Dubai Marina, and Arabian Gulf
Exclusive W Whatever/Whenever signature concierge services
Private residents' beach club and infinity lagoon pool
Wellness center, treatment rooms, and fitness studio
Yacht docking berths at Dubai Harbour marina

investment_highlights: Dubai Harbour is the largest marina in the Middle East; exceptional capital appreciation and prime global rental demand.

name: DG1 Living

Burj Khalifa and Dubai Canal dual-aspect panoramas
Rooftop infinity sky pool
Outdoor cinema and co-working lounge spaces
Smart security access and high-speed elevators

investment_highlights: Competitive entry price in Business Bay, high ROI, rapid capital appreciation in Dubai's financial corridor.

name: Les Vagues by Elie Saab

name: The Astbury Estate

investment_highlights: Attractive UK staycation rental yields, no international buyer restrictions, fully managed holiday home model.
